# GO! Van

> GO! Van (drinks & smiles) is an event entertainment business from Sparta, Greece. One team brings a 360 Video Booth, a Mirror Photo Booth, an Audio Guestbook, a Cocktail Van Bar in a VW T2 van and a Portable Bar to weddings, christenings, shop openings, corporate events and parties. Booking several services together always costs less than booking them separately. The site has no prices: visitors ask for a quote.

- Area: Laconia and Sparta first, then Kalamata, Tripoli and the rest of the Peloponnese. Athens and the rest of Greece by arrangement.
- Contact: phone, Viber and WhatsApp +30 698 784 0740 · govangreece@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/govan.official/ · TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@govangreece

## Pages

- [GO! Van, in Greek](https://govangreece.gr/): services, signature cocktails named after you, gallery, Google reviews, FAQ and the quote form

## Services

- Mirror Photo Booth (GO! Magic Mirror): touch-screen mirror, unlimited 5x15 prints, props, custom print design, attendant. 4-hour base package.
- 360 Video Booth (GO! 360): slow-motion 360° videos with your song, names and logo. Classic (up to 4 people) or Overhead (10+ people). 4-hour base package.
- Audio Guestbook (GO! Guestbook): a vintage phone where guests leave spoken wishes, delivered on a USB stick. No power needed.
- Cocktail Van Bar: the VW van as a bar. Full service (bartenders, ingredients, drinks, cocktails with or without alcohol) or semi service (the van and its equipment for your own bartenders).
- Portable Bar: the bar with the VW front, for venues the van can't enter. With or without a bartender.

## Practical

- Needs a power socket (except the guestbook phone) and, if it rains outdoors, a covered space.
- Set-up starts at least an hour before guests arrive.
- Photos, videos and messages are delivered 1–2 days after the event.
- Booking at least six months ahead is suggested; the date is secured with a small deposit.
